0: AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE LAND DEVELOPMENT ORDINANCES OF GOOD HOPE, GEORGIA THE MAYOR AND THE COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF GOOD HOPE, GEORGIA HEREBY ORDAIN AS FOLLOWS:
1:
The Land Development Ordinance of Good Hope, Georgia, officially adopted in October 1985, as thereafter amended, is hereby amended by implementing the below amendments as follows: 1. Article 2. Definitions and Interpretations: Section 2.08 Definitions-H is hereby amended by adding and including the following definition and interpretation to this Section: House Rental: A residence that is rented to a third party based on the requirement set forth in an annual lease. 2. Article 2. Definitions and Interpretations: Section 2.19 Definitions-S is hereby amended by adding and including the following definition and interpretation to this Section: Short-Term Rental: The maximum time period for a Short-Term Rental may be rented is seven (7) days, and the maximum number of such 7 day rentals in a calendar year is fifty-two (52). 3.
